description: Compare a document snapshot against the current document text, or against another snapshot (pass againstSnapshotId). Returns the paragraphs added and removed and the net word-count change — use this to see what changed since a snapshot was taken. Read-only. Requires an open project (call open_project first). Get snapshot ids from list_snapshots.

againstSnapshotId.description: Optional second snapshot id to compare against. Omit to compare against the current document text.

name: compare_snapshot

addedParagraphs.description: Paragraphs present in the compared-to text but not the snapshot.

removedParagraphs.description: Paragraphs present in the snapshot but not the compared-to text.

to.description: What it was compared against ("current" or a snapshot id).

unchangedParagraphs.description: Count of paragraphs common to both.

wordDelta.description: to.wordCount minus from.wordCount (negative means text was cut).

wordsAdded.description: Words present in the compared-to text but not the snapshot (word-level).

wordsRemoved.description: Words present in the snapshot but not the compared-to text (word-level).

title: Compare Snapshot
